title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run scheduled for spring 2027, her first full tour in the region since 2025.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run scheduled for spring 2027, her first full tour in the region since 2025. It follows a year in which she returned to live work gradually, first through individual performances and then festival appearances. The announcement puts a multi-week headline run back on her calendar after the tour she had planned around *I'm Only F**king Myself* was cancelled.

That pause began after Young collapsed during her set at All Things Go in New York in September 2025. A few days later, she cancelled every upcoming performance for the foreseeable future, including the North American dates that had been due to follow the album. She said she needed time to work on herself and did not offer a date for returning. Her first substantial public update after the break was similarly cautious, saying she hoped to get back to performing gradually during 2026 instead of treating the next appearance as an immediate return to full-time touring.

The first major marker came at the Grammys in February. "Messy" won Best Pop Solo Performance and Young performed the song on the broadcast, then resumed headline shows in the UK before moving back onto festival stages. Later in the year she returned to All Things Go, the same festival where the 2025 break had begun. By the time the new tour was announced, she had spent most of 2026 performing again without committing to another long North American itinerary.

[apple:song:6768357139:6768357142]

New music arrived in the middle of that process. "From Down Here," released in May and made with James Blake, came from an idea Young says arrived the morning after her Grammy win. She described the song as being about missing an old high while knowing that a more grounded life is safer and ultimately more rewarding. The track is calmer than much of the album without losing the bluntness that made "Messy" connect, and it gives the 2027 shows material written after the break rather than only songs from the cycle that was interrupted by it.

The tour title reverses Young's "Everything Ends" tattoo. The 2025 cancellations came without replacement dates, while her return through 2026 remained deliberately piecemeal, just as she had said it would be. Everything Begins is the first full North American tour she has put on sale since stepping away. It comes after a year in which the comeback was measured in individual shows and festival sets rather than another long run announced all at once.
